root.name: Sicilian Defense: Coles Sicilian Gambit
root.moves: 1. e4 c5 2. d4 cxd4 3. Qxd4 Nc6 4. Qd1 Nf6 5. Bc4

overview: White recaptures on d4 with the queen, retreats it, and plays Bc4 aiming at f7 while the e4 pawn is loose. Black can take e4 with the knight and White gets a lead in development for the pawn. It is a rare, tricky sideline of the Sicilian.

white_ideas.idea: Hit f7 with Bc4 and Qd5-type ideas

black_ideas.idea: Take e4 and then trade pieces

typical_structures.structure: Open centre with the c-pawn gone

character.notes: Tactical with a loose e4 and Bxf7 tricks.

gambit.notes: Black wins the e4 pawn with ...Nxe4.

sublines_that_differ.name: Smith-Morra
sublines_that_differ.how: the main gambit with pawn on c3

gambit.reason: White leaves e4 attacked for tempo.

soundness.reason: The compensation is thin against accurate play.

structure.reason: The c-pawn is gone, typical for a Sicilian.

plans.reason: Bc4 and quick development point at f7.
